transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, for the past 10 months, I've been feeling this overwhelming surge of energy where my mood is incredibly high, but I also get extremely irritable over the smallest things. I'm constantly hyperactive and feel like I just can't sit still or stop moving. It's like my engine is running on overdrive all the time.
Have you struggled with these feelings of high energy and hyperactivity since childhood, or is this 10-month period a clear change from how you normally feel?

This is definitely a very sudden and clear change from how I normally feel, and it only started 10 months ago. I never experienced this kind of intense energy or hyperactivity when I was a child. Before this, my life was much more calm and normal.
During this 10-month period of high energy, have you experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or holding beliefs that others found highly unusual?

Yes, I have. When my energy is at its peak, I hear voices that others can't hear and feel convinced that I have special powers or that people are monitoring me. These strange experiences only happen during those times when my mind and energy are completely in overdrive.
To help me rule out other causes, are you currently using any recreational substances, taking new medications, or do you have any medical conditions like thyroid issues?

No, I don't use any recreational substances or take any new medications. I also don't have any known medical conditions like thyroid issues. My physical health has always been pretty normal otherwise.
